name: Shredder
summary: A charcoal Delete button whose amber bin grows, catches a tumbling page and shreds it to confetti
about: Shredder is a dark Delete button with a solid amber bin inside. On press the bin crouches, springs to the middle, grows and opens; a page tumbles in, splits into strips and sinks into the buzzing bin. The lid snaps shut and a shower of paper confetti flies out. It makes deleting invoices, files or records feel final and a little fun.
how: Hover to see the lid peek; press Delete file.
The button presses down, the bin crouches, then springs to the middle, grows and flips its lid open.
A page tumbles in, splits into strips and sinks into the buzzing bin while paper bits fly.
The lid snaps shut with a squash, paper confetti showers out and the label springs in as Shredded, then it resets.
